meta.name: Port / Rail Cash-Flow Value + Reviewed Business Sources V5.5j
meta.objective: Keep V5.5i scoring unchanged and repair company-specific PIT business-purity evidence for reviewed port/rail source formats.

universe.name: A-share port and railway infrastructure operators
universe.construction: V5.5g repaired PIT port/rail universe filtered by V5.5j reviewed business evidence. Core port/rail operator tags are allowed; supply-chain/trade-dominant companies remain excluded.

data.vendor: JoinQuant/DataJQ PIT financial fields + V5.5g repaired universe + V5.5j reviewed Eastmoney/Sina annual-report business-purity evidence
data.operating_state_policy: operating_state_score remains diagnostic only with zero scoring weight. V5.5i adds a PIT business-purity gate and does not change factors or weights.
data.source_warning: V5.5j repairs 601326, 601880 and 601333 company-specific segment formats with original annual-report evidence. This is a data-source repair, not factor tuning.

factors.name: operating_cash_flow_yield
factors.definition: Operating cash flow divided by market capitalization.

factors.name: free_cash_flow_yield
factors.definition: Operating cash flow minus capex, divided by market capitalization.

factors.name: capex_burden
factors.definition: Cash paid for fixed / intangible assets divided by operating cash flow.

factors.name: operating_state_score
factors.definition: Cross-sectional operating-state score retained for diagnostics and coverage checks. Weight is zero.

scoring.value_trap_guard: Operating state is diagnostic only. No hard guard is approved until original throughput / freight evidence is reviewed.

schedule.rebalance_rule: first tradable day after 2021-05-01 startup catch-up, then first tradable day of quarter after PIT visibility check

portfolio.cash_policy: hold residual cash when fewer than eight names pass filters; V5.5g explicitly allows May startup catch-up signal for the 2021-05 comparison window

defensive_rule.reason: V5.5c is a research PIT candidate, not a defensive timing model.

individual_stop_loss_take_profit.reason: Fixed exits are not part of the research hypothesis.

validation.acceptance_rule: V5.5g can only supersede V5.5c for local engineering if the 2021 PIT universe repair is disclosed and formal validation remains stable. Historical return alone is insufficient.

name: Port / Rail Cashflow Value Operating Diagnostic V5.5i Business Purity Gate

metadata.pm_decision: V5.5i keeps V5.5g scoring unchanged and applies a PIT-visible core port/rail business-purity gate before validation.
